# Canyoning Sri Lanka

> Canyoning Sri Lanka (canyoningsrilanka.com) is an adventure company in Kitulgala, Sri Lanka, on the Kelani River about 87 km (2.5–3 hours) from Colombo. It offers white water rafting (5 km and 10 km), canyoning (Normal, Marvel and Watagala), waterfall abseiling (Sandun Ella, Mannakathi Ella, Kataran Ella), a 200 m zip line, Makandawa jungle trekking, the Belilena cave hike and cycling. All bookings are made through the business WhatsApp (https://wa.me/94770000000). There is no online payment.

## Activities
### White Water Rafting
- [White Water Rafting in Kitulgala](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/white-water-rafting-kitulgala/): Kitulgala is where white water rafting in Sri Lanka began, and the Kelani River is still the best place in the country to do it. The river drops out of the central hills through thick rainforest, giving fast, splashy rapids between calm stretches where you can float, swim and look up at the jungle. Pick the 5 km run for a fun first taste or the 10 km run for the full river.
- [5 km White Water Rafting](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/white-water-rafting-kitulgala/5km-rafting/): The classic Kelani River run, with fun rapids, calm pools and jungle all around. Perfect for first-timers. Duration ≈ 1 – 1.5 hrs; minimum age 8+; level Beginner; price on request via WhatsApp.
- [10 km White Water Rafting](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/white-water-rafting-kitulgala/10km-rafting/): Double the river and double the rapids. The full Kitulgala run for people who want more. Duration ≈ 2 – 2.5 hrs; minimum age 12+; level Intermediate; price on request via WhatsApp.

### Canyoning
- [Canyoning in Sri Lanka](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/canyoning-sri-lanka/): Canyoning means following a jungle stream down through the forest by sliding down smooth rock chutes, jumping into deep pools and climbing down rope sections beside waterfalls. Kitulgala's rainforest streams make it the canyoning capital of Sri Lanka. We run one canyon for first-timers and two advanced canyons for people who want more.
- [Normal Canyoning](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/canyoning-sri-lanka/kitulgala-canyoning/): Natural rock slides, jumps into jungle pools and stream walks. The perfect first canyon. Duration ≈ 1.5 – 2 hrs; minimum age 10+; level Beginner; price on request via WhatsApp.
- [Marvel Canyoning](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/canyoning-sri-lanka/marvel-canyoning/): Bigger jumps, longer slides and roped sections. The advanced canyon for confident adventurers. Duration ≈ 3 hrs; minimum age 14+; level Advanced; price on request via WhatsApp.
- [Watagala Canyoning](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/canyoning-sri-lanka/watagala-canyoning/): A remote, wild canyon with narrow gorges, rope work and serious jumps. For experienced canyoners. Duration ≈ 3 – 4 hrs; minimum age 16+; level Advanced; price on request via WhatsApp.

### Waterfall Abseiling
- [Waterfall Abseiling in Sri Lanka](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/waterfall-abseiling-sri-lanka/): Waterfall abseiling means lowering yourself down a rope beside a waterfall while the water crashes past you. Kitulgala has three waterfalls we abseil — Sandun Ella, Mannakathi Ella and Kataran Ella — each with its own height, rock and feel.
- [Sandun Ella Waterfall Abseiling](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/waterfall-abseiling-sri-lanka/sandun-ella-abseiling/): Rope down beside the falling water at Sandun Ella, Kitulgala's signature abseil. Duration ≈ 2 – 3 hrs; minimum age 12+; level Beginner; price on request via WhatsApp.
- [Mannakathi Ella Waterfall Abseiling](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/waterfall-abseiling-sri-lanka/mannakathi-ella-abseiling/): A tall, powerful fall over dark cliffs. The most dramatic abseil in Kitulgala. Duration ≈ 2.5 – 3 hrs; minimum age 14+; level Intermediate; price on request via WhatsApp.
- [Kataran Ella Waterfall Abseiling](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/waterfall-abseiling-sri-lanka/kataran-ella-abseiling/): Step down a tiered fall of granite ledges and pools in the heart of the rainforest. Duration ≈ 2 – 3 hrs; minimum age 12+; level Beginner; price on request via WhatsApp.

### More Adventures
- [More Things to Do in Kitulgala](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/kitulgala-adventures/): Kitulgala has more than rapids. Fly over the jungle on a 200 m zip line, walk through the Makandawa rainforest, hike to Belilena, one of Sri Lanka's oldest prehistoric caves, or cycle the village roads along the Kelani River.
- [Zip Lining (200 m)](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/kitulgala-adventures/zip-lining-kitulgala/): Fly 200 metres over the jungle on a steel cable. Short, fast and unforgettable. Duration ≈ 30 – 45 mins; minimum age 8+; level All levels; price on request via WhatsApp.
- [Jungle Trekking (Makandawa)](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/kitulgala-adventures/jungle-trekking-makandawa/): Walk deep into the Makandawa rainforest with a naturalist guide: giant trees, birds and streams. Duration ≈ 2 – 3 hrs; minimum age 6+; level Easy – Moderate; price on request via WhatsApp.
- [Belilena Hike](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/kitulgala-adventures/belilena-cave-hike/): Hike to Belilena, a prehistoric cave where people lived tens of thousands of years ago. Duration ≈ 2 hrs; minimum age 6+; level Easy; price on request via WhatsApp.
- [Cycling](https://canyoningsrilanka.com/kitulgala-adventures/cycling-kitulgala/): Ride rural roads and red-earth trails through villages, rubber estates and the river valley. Duration ≈ 2 – 3 hrs; minimum age 12+; level Easy – Moderate; price on request via WhatsApp.

## Getting there
- From Colombo: 87 km, 2.5 – 3 hrs (A4 to Avissawella, then the A7 towards Hatton)
- From Bandaranaike Airport (CMB): 95 km, 2.5 – 3 hrs (Outer Circular Expressway to Kaduwela, then A4 / A7)
- From Kandy: 60 km, ≈ 2 hrs (Via Gampola, Nawalapitiya and Ginigathhena)
- From Nuwara Eliya: 75 km, 2 – 2.5 hrs (Via Hatton and Ginigathhena)
- From Hatton / Adam's Peak: 40 km, ≈ 1.5 hrs (A7 west through Ginigathhena)

## FAQ
- **Where is Kitulgala and how do I get there?** Kitulgala is a rainforest village on the Kelani River in Sri Lanka's Kegalle District, on the A7 road between Avissawella and Hatton. It's about 87 km (2.5–3 hours) from Colombo, about 2 hours from Kandy and 2–2.5 hours from Nuwara Eliya. We can help arrange pickup — just ask on WhatsApp.
- **How do I book?** Tap any 'Book on WhatsApp' button, add your name, date and group size, and WhatsApp opens with your booking message already written. Press send and our team will confirm availability, pickup and payment details in the chat.
- **Do I pay online?** No. There's no online payment on this website. Our team will confirm your booking and any advance payment directly with you on WhatsApp.
- **Is it safe?** Every activity is led by trained guides, and all safety equipment is provided: helmets, life jackets, harnesses and ropes, depending on the activity. Each trip starts with a safety briefing, and we only run activities when river and weather conditions are right.
- **Do I need previous experience?** No experience is needed for rafting, Normal Canyoning, waterfall abseiling, the zip line or the hikes. Marvel Canyoning and Watagala Canyoning are advanced and best for fit, confident swimmers.
- **What's the minimum age?** It depends on the activity, from about 6 years for easy hikes to 14–16 years for advanced canyoning. You'll find the minimum age on each activity page. Ask us on WhatsApp if you're unsure.
- **What should I bring?** Swimwear or quick-dry clothes, shoes with straps or grip that can get wet, a towel, a change of clothes, sunscreen and water. We provide all the technical safety gear.
- **When is the best time to visit Kitulgala?** Adventures run all year. Kitulgala gets rain in both monsoons, which keeps the rivers and waterfalls flowing. River levels change day to day, so we confirm conditions on WhatsApp before your trip.
- **Can I choose my guide?** You can ask! Mention the guide's name in your WhatsApp booking message and we'll do our best to match you, depending on schedules.
